records.endDes: You have chosen "The Destroyer Action Guide," "Source Citadel Rescue Manual," and "Tauri Robot and Motorcycle Repair Tech." These practical pieces of knowledge are sure to be helpful.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/散落的书籍/挑几本看起来值钱的
records.endDes: You have chosen uncommon books like "Selection of Empire History," "Unknown Mushroom Village Nursery Rhymes," and "The Legend of the Solar Sword Maiden." If you take them back to the outside world, they should be able to sell for a good price... probably?

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/散落的书籍/收拾好放归原处
records.endDes: You tidy up the books one by one and return them to the bookshelf. At the bottom of the messy pile of books, you find an exquisite old bookmark. After touching it, a sense of hope for the future seems to flow into your mind.

records.endDes: The guiding robot obediently follows you, illuminating the path ahead.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/指引灯光/看看它要去哪
records.endDes: The guiding robot starts leading the way. Soon, under its guidance, you discover some useful items.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/神秘光束/向着光走
records.endDes: Without sensing any sign of danger, you decide to move forward toward the light to investigate, but fail to find any source of it. Soon, the light vanishes, leaving only floating specks of dust around.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/神秘光束/原地休息
records.endDes: You decide not to act rashly and rest for a moment in this warm glow. Soon, the glow vanishes, and you regain some strength to continue moving forward.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/求真者/观察她
records.endDes: She occasionally stops to think and sometimes wanders alone. Finally, she turns her head to look at you — this makes you feel a bout of dizziness. However, it seems that you recall something from that gaze...

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/求真者/无视她
records.optionDes: Gain 1 Rotate attempt in this turn.
records.endDes: Your intuition tells you that this illusion is untouchable. Pretending you have never met her, you walk away.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中右手/放上一件装备
records.endDes: You place a dice on it, and it vanishes immediately. A moment later, another brand new dice appears in your hand.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中右手/与其猜拳
records.endDes: You play scissors against its outstretched hand, and the arm jolts to a stunned halt as if lost in thought. After a moment, it slams a small pouch down right in front of you.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中右手/与其友好握手
records.endDes: You take the hand and greet it.

records.optionDes: All allies heal for 20% of Max HP.
records.endDes: Recalling the image in video games where the player gains HP by sipping from a spring, you find yourself inexplicably kneeling by the pool, scooping up a handful of water and bringing it to your lips. The cool, sweet taste refreshes your spirit, and you regain some strength.

肉鸽事件/事件选项/许愿池/跳入水中
records.endDes: You recall an imperial legend. "They say there's a vast glowing lake far beyond. Dive into it with a devout wish, and you shall be granted boundless power!" You leap into the water. When you come to again, you lie on the cold floor, holding something tightly in your hand.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/思乡曲/欣赏音乐
records.optionDes: All allies heal for 20% of Max HP.
records.endDes: To stay safe, you choose to wait right there until the melody ends — for some reason, you are certain it is drawing to a close. As the music fades away, you regain some strength in this brief respite. It is time to move on.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/思乡曲/寻找声音的源头
records.endDes: You choose to seek the source of the music. The moment you spot the unplayed harp, the melody stops at once — as if the mysterious player had just left in a flutter of sleeves the second before. Beneath the seat lies a faintly familiar item.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/断裂线缆/尝试维修
records.endDes: Drawing on your knowledge of engineering, physics and electrical engineering, and assisted by proper tools and your Ascension Abilities, you successfully repair the broken cable.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/断裂线缆/正好让我荡过去
records.optionDes: Gain 1 Rotate attempt in this turn.
records.endDes: Fortune favors the brave! Like the protagonist of "Ward the Ape Man," you grab the end of the cable and swing across the puddle.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/紧闭门扉/寻找开门之法
records.endDes: You try every method you can think of, racking your brains to find a way to open the door, yet all attempts end in failure. You prepare to leave and seek another path, only to find the door has been left slightly ajar. Perhaps the effort itself is what makes it beautiful.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/紧闭门扉/大力出奇迹！
records.endDes: You resolutely decide to break down the door by force! But in the very instant before you launch your attack, the door vanishes as if it never existed at all, leaving only an empty corridor and the path ahead. ...Maybe even doors are cowards?

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/突发停电/深入黑暗
records.endDes: You step into the darkness, encouraging each other. Light soon appears ahead, and you gain courage as you walk this dangerous path together.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/突发停电/趁黑睡觉
records.endDes: In the darkness, someone lights a lamp and sets up a simple camp. You choose to rest here for a while before moving on.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/昴昴朋友/请求指引
records.endDes: Moments later, the robot points out the correct route for you with a laser. Trusting in Rebis's technological prowess, you follow the beam of light and press on.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/昴昴朋友/请求帮助
records.endDes: Moments later, silhouettes of several items appear in the robot's projection. It seems you can choose one by touching it to make it real. With this gift in hand, you press onward.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/废弃车站/下意识到走到交易所
records.endDes: 交易所里没有跑来跑去的“黄金坞”，也没有坐镇全场的娃娃鱼，只有大厅中央散落着的些许微尘。

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/废弃车站/寻找补给
records.optionDes: Gain 1 Move attempt in this turn.
records.endDes: 休息区的设备十分完整，只是由于久未使用而落满了灰尘。你找到了一些食物，在休息区好好睡了一觉。再次睁开眼睛时，你又回到了原来的通道中。

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/废弃车站/这是家吗？
records.endDes: 不知为何，这个车站给人一种令人熟悉的感觉。你将曾在梦中见过的车站在脑海中描绘……然而，不等你判断，周围的幻象很快消散了，你又回到了通道之中。

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/自动工坊/按下按钮
records.endDes: The machine activates and finishes its preset production process. A brand-new usable item appears at the end of the production line.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/自动工坊/研究其原理
records.endDes: You dismantle the machine's control system. It boasts a structure unlike anything you've ever seen, yet the passage of time has long proven its reliability.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/自动工坊/打造一张床
records.endDes: You recompile the production process and make it create something fun.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/熟悉的图书馆/打开抽屉
records.endDes: The drawer contains stationery and other daily necessities in common use. Among the scattered tools, you spot some fine dust.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/熟悉的图书馆/拿走笔记
records.endDes: The notes, written in familiar handwriting, record daily observations and insights into the Angel Project. With this notebook, you should be able to understand certain things on a deeper level.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/熟悉的图书馆/翻找箱子
records.endDes: There are some useful items in the box.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/陌生的图书馆/打开抽屉
records.endDes: The drawer contains nothing but a few specks of dust.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/陌生的图书馆/拿走笔记
records.endDes: The notebook is covered in dense writing, but before you can look closely, its shape shifts into a damaged cassette tape with a torn magnetic strip... It's probably unplayable now.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/陌生的图书馆/翻找箱子
records.endDes: Most of the supplies and gear inside the box are damaged beyond use. You find nothing useful, collect your thoughts, and set off again.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/地板塌陷/快速通过
records.optionDes: All allies lose 10% of Max HP, and gain 100 [Dust].
records.endDes: Halfway along, you step on a sunken patch and nearly fall. Fortunately, you only get a scrape, and unexpectedly find some dust.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/地板塌陷/小心通过
records.optionDes: Gain 1 Move attempt in this turn.
records.endDes: You take each step carefully and finally pass through safely.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/图纸与工坊/分析设计图
records.optionDes: Choose and discard 1 <color=#5a8ef9>Blue</color> [Ascent], and gain 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> or <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: You try to analyze one of the blueprints. Though you don't fully understand it, you gain plenty of inspiration.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/图纸与工坊/按图制造
records.optionDes: Choose and discard 1 <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent], and gain 1 random [Dice].
records.endDes: You select an understandable blueprint and attempt to craft the item. It takes a great deal of mental effort, but you successfully build a functional item.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/图纸与工坊/无视它
records.endDes: You have no time to dwell on trivial matters here and turn to leave.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/轨道交通/尝试启动它
records.optionDes: Choose and discard 1 [Ascent], and gain 1 random [Ascent].
records.endDes: You summon your courage and step into the train cab. After your bold attempts, it actually starts up. But moments after the engine roars back to life, it lets out a heavy, deep sigh, and the cab falls silent once more.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/轨道交通/搜索车厢
records.optionDes: Choose and discard 1 [Dice], and gain 1 random [Dice].
records.endDes: You enter the carriage to look around and unexpectedly find a dusty supply under the seat. But you can no longer carry anything else, forcing you to make a choice.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/轨道交通/透过窗玻璃查看内部
records.endDes: To be safe, you decide to check the situation from outside first. But the window is covered in dust and scratches, leaving you unable to see anything inside. You have no choice but to leave in regret.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/日食/前往远处灯塔
records.optionDes: All allies lose 15% of Max HP, and gain 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: You set off on the path in pursuit of the light. Though the journey is fraught with rough and rugged obstacles, the ever-brighter glow ahead grants you endless comfort and peace of mind.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/日食/跟随音乐的指引
records.optionDes: All allies lose 10% of Max HP, and gain 1 random <color=#5a8ef9>Blue</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: You leave following the sound of music. The journey feels endlessly long, yet your spirit is incredibly exhilarated.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/日食/穿过迷雾
records.optionDes: All allies lose 20% of Max HP, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: You try to walk through the mist alone. The music and light fade away little by little, leaving only the dark sun and endless emptiness by your side. Fear and cold gnaw at your body, yet deep within your chest, a heart beats with astonishing force, pumping scalding blood to every part of you.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中左手/放上50点【尘埃】
records.endDes: You place some dust onto the left pan of the balance. The right pan tilts slightly, and the flowing crimson liquid nourishes your skin —

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/日食/这不是真的
records.endDes: You close your eyes, letting go of everything around you. The darkness fades, and you find yourself back where you were before.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中左手/放上100点【尘埃】
records.endDes: You place a handful of dust onto the left pan of the balance. The right pan tilts, and the flowing liquid fills your palm.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中左手/放上400点【尘埃】
records.endDes: You pile as much dust as you can onto the left pan of the balance. The scale tips out of balance and slips from that hand in an instant, spilling the bright red liquid all over the ground. When you come to your senses, both the balance and the hand have vanished without a trace.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中左手/与其友好握手
records.endDes: You hold the hand, expressing your care for it.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/势利眼的观测者/亮眼的打扮
records.endDes: The witch says to you: "An unexpected interpretation. Not even I can stand in the way of your magnificence."

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/势利眼的观测者/奢华的打扮
records.endDes: Luxurious and elegant, it looks exceptionally proper. You buy it at a very favorable price.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/势利眼的观测者/平平无奇的打扮
records.endDes: You feel you are well-dressed and see no need for change.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/塔/祈求力量
records.optionDes: Lose 1 Action Point, and gain 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: You receive a powerful revelation, feeling more capable and in control than before. Truly an unexpected blessing.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/塔/祈求财富
records.endDes: ...You thought you'd get BCRL Coins, but its understanding seems to differ from yours. Still, something is better than nothing.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/塔/祈求健康
records.optionDes: Lose 1 Action Point, and heal all allies for 15% of Max HP.
records.endDes: Your exhausted body seems to have improved a little from earlier. It appears this is its limit.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/唾手可得的奖励/借助工具拿到箱子
records.endDes: You choose not to take the risk and skillfully use tools to retrieve the box. Yet the items inside have already been damaged. But you gain some experience in using tools, so it is not entirely a bad thing.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/塔/祈求放假
records.endDes: Even the Wishing Tower has things it cannot do.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/唾手可得的奖励/依靠岩石般的体格硬抗
records.optionDes: All allies lose 20% of Max HP, and gain 1 random [Dice].
records.endDes: No matter how agile and careful you are, you inevitably get hurt by the traps. Inside the box is a useful item, making your effort worthwhile.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/唾手可得的奖励/放弃离开
records.endDes: Is it really worth taking such a big risk just for one box? You believe there will be better opportunities ahead.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/雾中歌声/这种虎就该打
records.optionDes: All allies lose 20% of Max HP, and enhance 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: Perhaps you have wanted to do this for a long time, so you strike out decisively and punch it. Your hand throbs with pain, while the HowlingBox remains completely unharmed. But it stops singing, and you finally find peace.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/雾中歌声/忍一忍等它唱完
records.optionDes: Lose 1 Action Point, and gain 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: You can do nothing about it but endure in silence. As its song lingers on, your thoughts gradually drift, and unexpectedly, some strange ideas cross your mind.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/雾中歌声/只能用金钱对付它了
records.endDes: You hand over part of your dust, and it steps aside to spit out a large dice! You think resentfully that perhaps it obtained the dust around it in this very way...

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/雾中歌声/掉头就走
records.endDes: You don't want to waste energy dealing with this weird box. If you can't fight it, you can at least avoid it.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中大嘴/投入骰子
records.optionDes: Choose and discard 1 [Dice], and gain 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> or <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: Its maw opens and closes, and from it comes a narration composed almost entirely of hums... Incredibly, you understand the story it tells.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中大嘴/投入尘埃
records.optionDes: Lose 100 [Dust], and heal all allies for 20% of Max HP.
records.endDes: Its maw opens and closes, and a melodious and beautiful song flows out from it. The song calms the minds of you and the other explorers.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中大嘴/伸手进去掏一掏
records.optionDes: Choose and discard 1 [Ascent], and gain 1 random [Dice].
records.endDes: Legend holds that those who dare to reach their hands into the gaping maw on the wall are free of hypocrisy and evil. You place your hand inside... nothing terrible happens. Instead, you gain some courage.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/墙中大嘴/喂大嘴吃土
records.endDes: You lift a handful of dirt and stuff it into the huge mouth. The mouth gapes blankly, then slowly disintegrates and vanishes.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/乐器和乐谱/用来打架也很趁手
records.endDes: You pick up the violin and wield it tentatively. The strings resonate with the wind, producing healing melodies. But before you can listen closely, the violin shatters from your rough movement, and something falling out of it cuts your hand.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/乐器和乐谱/让莉薇娅演奏
records.optionDes: Gain 1 random <color=#5b5b5b>Black</color> [Dice], and 1 Move attempt in this turn.
records.endDes: Strangely enough, the moment Livia picks up the violin, the strings glow brilliantly. When the melody ends, you feel instantly refreshed, your mind clears, as if guided by some mysterious power.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/乐器和乐谱/自己演奏试试
records.optionDes: Lose 2 Action Points, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Dice].
records.endDes: The violin seems to possess a certain magic. Though unskilled, you complete the performance with some invisible assistance. The melodic tune grants you a touch of inspiration and motivation.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/乐器和乐谱/总觉得有点诡异
records.endDes: Such a thing seems useless, so you leave it untouched.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/塔中魔方/向左转动魔方
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Ascent] and 100 [Dust] after victory.
records.endDes: After rotating the Cube leftward, a path to another space appears ahead, exuding a faint sense of danger... Yet once you cross this obstacle, the road ahead will grow much smoother.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/塔中魔方/向右转动魔方
records.endDes: You seem to successfully avoid an unknown danger, but you also pay the necessary price for it.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/战斗模拟系统/让我试试
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 1 random [Ascent] after victory.
records.endDes: You can't wait to operate the device. After successfully completing the combat training, you feel that your strength has truly improved.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/战斗模拟系统/不太可靠
records.optionDes: Lose 1 random [Ascent], and heal all allies for 10% of Max HP.
records.endDes: You decide not to take the risk and stay in the room to rest for a while. When you leave, you feel a bit fuzzy-headed, probably from sleeping too long.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/防御系统故障/原地迎战
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 100 [Dust] after victory.
records.endDes: You defeat the runaway robots and collect some scattered dust.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/防御系统故障/找个地方躲起来
records.optionDes: All allies lose 20% of Max HP, and gain 50-150 [Dust].
records.endDes: You find a hiding place, but still get injured by the rampaging robots. Fortunately, you discover some dust in your hiding spot.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/黑8/我掉的是银台球
records.optionName: I dropped a silver cue ball.
records.optionDes: Enter a tough battle, and enhance 3 random [Ascent] after victory.
records.endDes: Rebis's robots swarm toward you. You struggle for a while before claiming victory. Rebis casually tosses a silver cue ball to you, its glinting silver light seeming to brighten your train of thought.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/黑8/我掉的是金台球
records.optionName: I dropped a golden cue ball.
records.optionDes: Enter a tough battle, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Ascent] after victory.
records.endDes: Several Citadel members engage you in battle. You struggle for some time before claiming victory. Rebis laughs heartily and praises you generously, handing you the golden cue ball. Its dazzling golden light grants you a mysterious revelation.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/黑8/我掉的只是一个黑色的台球
records.optionName: I dropped a black cue ball.
records.optionDes: Enter a tough battle, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Dice] and 1 random <color=#5b5b5b>Black</color> [Dice] after victory.
records.endDes: "Honest and trustworthy, I like that!" With that, Rebis personally steps into the fray! After barely finishing the battle, Rebis tosses two dice before you can even complain, cutting you off.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/黑8/可以和解吗？
records.optionDes: All allies lose 20% of Max HP and gain 1 random <color=#5b5b5b>Black</color> [Dice].
records.endDes: Rebis shakes her head regretfully, hands you a red cue ball, then departs. The second she leaves, the red cue ball suddenly explodes, leaving you covered in dust and grime from the powder inside.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/狭路相逢/以和为贵
records.endDes: You have no intention of fighting them here and choose to offer some benefits to settle the matter. Seeing your courtesy, they thank you sensibly and disperse.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/狭路相逢/手下败将不足为惧
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 1 random [Dice] after victory.
records.endDes: You give them a ruthless "lesson," and they offer you a profound confession.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/狭路相逢/是云岫桥裁缝！
records.endDes: You happen to plan to mend your tattered clothes. Seeing this, they use the skills they learned at Yunxiu Bridge and strike up a pleasant trade with you.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/倒悬高塔/从墙上拿下一件物品后从窗户离开
records.optionDes: All allies lose 50% of Max HP, and gain 1 random <color=#ec731a>Orange</color> [Dice].
records.endDes: Jumping out of the window inflicts severe injuries on you, yet your efforts are not entirely in vain.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/倒悬高塔/尝试用手中的物品嵌入锁孔
records.endDes: When you insert the corresponding item into the keyhole, the door opens at once. You also find a valuable item behind the door.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/倒悬高塔/强行突破
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Dice] after victory.
records.endDes: You defeat the guards lurking in the shadows, seize the spoils from them, and swagger off.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/隐士/婉拒并将自己的食物分给对方
records.endDes: He accepts your gift and gives you another box, inside of which you find some dust.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/隐士/接受对方的好意
records.optionDes: All allies lose 50% of Max HP, and gain 1 random <color=#ec731a>Orange</color> [Dice].
records.endDes: You eat the food, only to be seized by a sharp stomachache — it must have expired. Yet this encounter also gives you some insight.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/空中魔眼/平静地注释
records.endDes: You feel something slip into your mind, siphoning off a wisp of inspiration... yet it leaves you a reward in return.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/空中魔眼/瞪着它
records.endDes: Your provocation seems to enrage it, but you emerge victorious in the confrontation. It flees in panic, leaving behind some items it had no time to take.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/空中魔眼/让它闭上眼睛
records.endDes: You poke the eyeball hard. It trembles violently and sheds a flood of tears.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/锁孔魔方/选择左边的钥匙
records.optionDes: Choose and discard 1 [Ascent], and gain 1 Move attempt in this turn.
records.endDes: You pick up the key on the left and insert it into the keyhole. As the Cube rotates, a brand-new path unfolds before you, yet a wisp of inspiration seems to slip away.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/锁孔魔方/选择右边的钥匙
records.optionDes: Lose 200 [Dust], and gain 2 Move attempts in this turn.
records.endDes: You pick up the key on the right and insert it into the keyhole. As the Cube rotates, a brand-new path appears before you, yet part of your dust is lost.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/锁孔魔方/全都不选
records.endDes: You refuse to pay the price; giving up is the safer option.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/镜中魔方/对着镜子里的倒影伸手
records.optionDes: Lose 1 Action Point, and gain 2 Move attempts in this turn.
records.endDes: You feel a sudden weight in your hand — the Cube in the mirror has somehow fallen into your palm. As you rotate it, the mirror reveals a long corridor, which appears to be a shortcut.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/镜中魔方/直接将手探入镜子里
records.endDes: The mirror shatters into countless shards, impossible to piece back together no matter how you try. The Cube within it has vanished without a trace.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/猩红色的沙漏/走近观察
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Dice] after victory.
records.endDes: You place your hand on the hourglass to wipe off the dust, but it shatters instantly. The spilled crystals project a blurry phantom wielding a blade, lunging at you.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/猩红色的沙漏/没什么好看的
records.endDes: The hourglass gives you an eerie feeling all along; it's better not to approach it rashly.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/八音石01/哼唱石头的旋律
records.optionDes: All allies lose 15% of Max HP, and gain 1 random [Ascent].
records.endDes: You hum along to the melody emanating from the rock, and strangely enough, you feel instantly invigorated.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项/八音石01/在石头边休息
records.optionDes: Heal all allies for 15% of Max HP.
records.endDes: You lean against the rock to rest for a while. The melody lingers in your ears, relaxing both your body and mind.

肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/骨血终将汇流/相信自己的直觉
records.endDes: You can't think of any way this could backfire. Why not just accept his kindness?

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/骨血终将汇流/看着就是个很奇怪的人
records.endDes: Free favors often come with a far steeper price. What's more, this person is far too suspicious. To play it safe, you'd better ignore him.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/骨血终将汇流/握住对方的手，查探虚实
records.optionDes: All allies lose 50% of Max HP, and gain 1 random <color=#ec731a>Orange</color> [Dice].
records.endDes: As if in answer, he clasps your hands in his, like long-lost kin finally reunited to greet one another. Somehow, your eyelids grow heavy. He releases your hands, and you find a dice has been pressed into your palm.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/骨血终将汇流/撤回手，任结晶物质洒在地上
records.endDes: Your intuition tells you that you cannot bear the consequences they bring; it is better to cut your losses in time. You are just about to press him for what it is, only to find nothing but a glinting object where the young man once stood.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/骨血终将汇流/将结晶物质收入囊中
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain [Crimson Hourglass] after victory.
records.endDes: You try to secure these unique crystals, but they project several pitch-black sword silhouettes. You hastily parry, only to find the mysterious young man has long vanished into the shadows.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/扭蛋机/不去动它
records.endDes: You decide to keep your distance from this strange gacha machine. You turn and take no more than two steps before spotting something shiny at your feet.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/扭蛋机/扭扭试试
records.endDes: You decide to test your luck and see what this gacha machine will dispense... As you turn the knob, two capsules drop out from the slot!

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/扭蛋机/什么？！
records.endDes: You defeat the enemy that emerges from the gacha capsule. Fortunately, the dangerous gacha machine is also destroyed in the fight. The capsules that roll out are not eerie — they appear to be nothing but ordinary toys... You leave this place.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/给你“推力”
records.endDes: You've collected all kinds of buffs along the way. Maybe some of them are Chloe's favorites?

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/给你“尘埃”
records.endDes: You've collected quite a bit of Dust along the way. Perhaps Chloe needs it just as much as you do...

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/为啥要给你啊？！
records.endDes: You reject Chloe's offer, and she shrugs indifferently. "Fine, whatever. Since I haven't given you anything, I'll head back just the way I came. But you're in for a rough time. See ya~"

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/我要更强的推力
records.optionDes: Lose 1 random <color=#5a8ef9>Blue</color> [Ascent], and gain 2 random <color=#5a8ef9>Blue</color> or <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent].
records.endDes: "I get it~" Chloe quickly floats in front of you and flicks your forehead with her bent finger. You clearly feel your power strengthen... Couldn't she have used a nicer way to do it? In the blink of an eye, a fierce wind whips up again, and Chloe's figure vanishes.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/我要更强的骰子
records.optionDes: Lose 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent], and gain 1 random <color=#5a8ef9>Blue</color> or <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Dice].
records.endDes: "Fine, fine! I'll give it to you..." Chloe pouts and shrugs, shoving a dice firmly into your hand. In the blink of an eye, a fierce wind whips up again, and Chloe's figure vanishes.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/算了，不值得
records.endDes: After carefully considering Chloe's terms, you decide not to go through with this special deal with her. Upon hearing your answer, she turns and leaves at once. As she departs, you could have sworn you heard a faint "tch"...

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/我要更强的推力1
records.endDes: "I get it~" Chloe quickly floats in front of you and flicks your forehead with her bent finger. You clearly feel your power strengthen... Couldn't she have used a nicer way to do it? In the blink of an eye, a fierce wind whips up again, and Chloe's figure vanishes.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/我要更强的骰子1
records.endDes: "Fine, fine! I'll give it to you..." Chloe pouts and shrugs, shoving a dice firmly into your hand. In the blink of an eye, a fierce wind whips up again, and Chloe's figure vanishes.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/彼如风暴/算了，不值得1
records.endDes: After carefully considering Chloe's terms, you decide not to go through with this special deal with her. Upon hearing your answer, she turns and leaves at once. As she departs, you could have sworn you heard a faint "tch"...

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/“二号躯体”/我不知道
records.endDes: "..." The girl gives no reaction to your answer; she simply stares deep into your eyes... Just as you start to feel uneasy, her body suddenly shatters, turning into a pile of dust on the ground.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/“二号躯体”/你是雅莱
records.endDes: "...Jalhay? Jalhay... That's right, that's the name she told me. But, why am I here?"

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/“二号躯体”/攻击她
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent] after victory.
records.endDes: You come to your senses — this is not Jalhay, merely an illusion forged from scattered consciousness. You defeat the enemy born of the hallucination and press onward.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/“二号躯体”/挽留她
records.optionDes: Enter a tough battle, and gain 1 random Golden [Ascent] after victory.
records.endDes: Even though you defeat the enemy emerging from within "Jalhay," the pale girl still vanishes. Yet in her final moment, she wears a smile that feels familiar to you. It is as if two overlapping voices speak to you... and you hear them clearly. "Thank you."

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/“二号躯体”/快逃！
records.endDes: You flee from where "Jalhay" resides, still shaken, escaping the monster born from her body.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/原型机/测一下！
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent] after victory.
records.endDes: You defeat Rebis's experimental subjects. Yet her excited demeanor seems rather odd... "You actually took down the prototypes of the Stars series? ...Oh right, it must be because of their terrible names! I'll take that Lissandra's advice and give them a resounding name... 'Tauri'!"

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/原型机/为啥要帮你啊？！
records.optionDes: Gain 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Dice], and something might happen.
records.endDes: Seeing you reluctant to cooperate, Rebis pulls something glittering from her pocket and tosses it to you. "This is your pay! I'm paying you in advance! Don't you dare run away, just stand right there!"

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/原型机/一动不动
records.endDes: The robot charges straight at you and knocks you to the ground... The pain is so intense that you are completely immobilized for a moment! But Rebis greatly commends your cooperation. She not only heals you but also gives you extra help.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/原型机/稍微躲开
records.endDes: The robot charges straight at you! Though you promised Rebis you wouldn't run, surely moving a little won't matter?! The robot brushes past you. Rebis mutters to herself as she recalls the robot, heals you slightly, then pats you on the shoulder and sends you on your way.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/原型机/拔腿就跑
records.endDes: No, you cannot agree to Rebis's unreasonable demands — at least, you shouldn't! You break into a run, leaving this dangerous experiment and this dangerous person far behind.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/虔诚祈祷/点头
records.endDes: "Then please step forward. I shall protect everyone." Her tone is perfectly calm, and you are not even sure if she recognizes you. You step forward and offer the dust you hold to that light.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/虔诚祈祷/摇头
records.endDes: You shake your head to decline participation, and Lissandra nods gently in understanding. Without further exchange, you leave.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/虔诚祈祷/继续祈祷
records.endDes: "What you reap shall exceed what you give."... It sounds promising. You decide to offer more dust.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/虔诚祈祷/选择离开
records.endDes: "To leave is also an act of honesty."... If that is so, you indeed have things to do and cannot linger here any longer. Taking the dust you have already obtained, you leave.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/虔诚祈祷/寻求建议
records.endDes: You ask Lissandra for more advice. She smiles and rests her hand gently on your shoulder, and you gain some incredible power... But when you come to your senses, the worshippers, Lissandra, and the dust you just offered are all gone.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/虔诚祈祷/收集尘埃
records.endDes: Lissandra looks slightly surprised. She watches as you gather the dust and leave this place. "I believe the wish you have made is a sincere one..."

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/虔诚祈祷/抓住骰子
records.endDes: Lissandra looks slightly surprised. She watches as you take the dice and leave this place. "...An object I have never seen before... Could it be..."

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/上前帮助
records.optionDes: Enter several tough battles. You will pay a price if you leave.
records.endDes: You rush forward. Dustin's gaze does not rest on you; he only stares into the emptiness behind you and issues commands calmly. This is an illusion of Dustin, not the man himself. What is he going through?

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/径直离开
records.endDes: Reason prevails over impulse, and you decide to leave this place. The moment you turn around, the figures of Dustin, "Celestial Fire," and the enemies all vanish like spent sparks.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/和他并肩作战
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Ascent] after victory.
records.endDes: "You still choose to stay after hearing what I said? ...Very well. I shall remember this brave act on behalf of all the Citadel Vanguards. Let us fight side by side."

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/交给他一些尘埃并离开
records.endDes: "...Thank you for your kindness. I will take these supplies. I promise we shall meet again, once we return to Senanonic."

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/为他提供掩护并离开
records.optionDes: All allies lose 20% of Max HP, and end the Vortex.
records.endDes: "Thanks for covering me — now get out of here! I'll hold this position!"

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/信赖他并离开
records.optionDes: Lose 1 Action Point, and end the event.
records.endDes: "Yes, you've done well. I will catch up to you soon, rest assured. Take these rations — they will come in handy."

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/战斗到底
records.optionDes: Enter a tough battle, and gain 1 random <color=#f4b71a>Golden</color> [Dice] after victory.
records.endDes: All enemies are defeated, and this hard-won victory is secured. Dustin's steel frame suddenly relaxes, then collapses and vanishes... The battle is an illusion, but the experience of fighting side by side is not.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/总有办法的
records.optionName: There will be a way out.
records.endDes: Dust is the minimal unit of memory. In this special space, it is both a resource and a weapon. You hand as much dust as possible to Dustin's illusion... There seems to be a smile on that mechanical face. You then suffer a brief lapse of memory, and when you wake up again, you are in a safe place.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项变化/坚守者/我要离开
records.optionDes: All allies lose 50% of Max HP, and end the Vortex.
records.endDes: You decide to flee. Dustin's illusion clears a path for you. Amid the urgency, you have no time to see how the battle unfolds behind you, yet the enemies nearly halt your progress. Keep moving forward.

records.endDes: The flame burns fiercely. When it calms down again, you find a dice of strange material within it.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/司书与提灯/什么也不做

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/谜团与提灯/往里倒入少量尘埃
records.optionName: Pour in a bit of dust.
records.endDes: The flame turns a vivid purple this time, a spark bursting at your fingertips. You remain unharmed, yet the sensation is utterly strange and wonderful.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/谜团与提灯/往里倒入适量尘埃
records.endDes: The flame burns intensely. When it settles again, you find an even more exquisite dice within it.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/谜团与提灯/什么也不做
records.endDes: As amazing as it is, you decide there's no need to keep putting in dust for further experiments right now.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/祝福与提灯/试着再往火焰里投入尘埃
records.endDes: You've just tossed in a pinch of dust, and the flame instantly turns dazzling gold. It feels like a beloved old friend, gently wrapping around your hand, leaving a lingering warmth that fades very slowly.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/祝福与提灯/擦拭提灯灯罩
records.endDes: You try to polish the lantern shade to make it brighter, but accidentally let a few specks of dust from your fingertips fall into the flame. The flame accepts them, and a wave of heat brushes over your fingertips.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/祝福与提灯/注视一会火焰
records.endDes: You gaze at the mesmerizing, beautiful flame in the lantern, feeling an unparalleled sense of peace. Afterwards, you bid farewell to Valentine and set off on your journey once more.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/理财产品/谨慎尝试
records.endDes: You spend a small amount of dust. Though Forton feels a bit regret, he accepts it gladly and promises not to let you down.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/理财产品/大胆尝试
records.optionDes: Deposit 150 [Dust] and receive interest when you enter next time.
records.endDes: You spend a large amount of dust, and Forton lavishes praises on you, vowing on the spot that he will make you a huge fortune.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/理财产品/听起来就不靠谱
records.endDes: You find it highly suspicious, and regardless of Forton's persistent persuasion, you resolutely leave.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/售后纠纷/少废话，还钱！
records.optionName: Shut up and pay me back!
records.optionDes: Enter a battle, and gain the deposited [Dust] and 50% interest after victory.
records.endDes: You pay no heed to his words, using force to firmly take back what is rightfully yours. Perhaps you have long wanted to do this in the trading center outside, which is why you act so decisively.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/售后纠纷/那就再试试
records.endDes: You are doubtful, yet decide to trust him one more time. You give him some more dust, but also warn him that if he dares to deceive you, you will show no mercy next time.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/售后纠纷/自认倒霉
records.endDes: You demand that he fulfill his promise at once, but when you see the bodyguards beside him, you have no choice but to consider yourself unlucky and leave.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/打击奸商/今天就要教你做鱼
records.optionDes: Enter a tough battle, and gain the accumulated deposited [Dust] and 100% interest after victory.
records.endDes: You ask Forton whether he prefers to be grilled or boiled. He trembles all over and says he would much rather be spared. He hands over your money plus double the interest, begging you to forgive his moment of madness.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/打击奸商/口头发泄一下离开
records.endDes: You weigh the situation and realize you may not be able to overpower the bodyguards, so you can only verbally vent your anger at being deceived. But the shouts of a loser only serve as accompaniment to the laughter of those who have succeeded.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/骑士训练/一起训练
records.optionDes: Choose and discard 1 [Ascent], and something might happen when entering again.
records.endDes: "Want to train with me? Sure, but it might be a little tough. If you get tired and want to stop, feel free to tell me anytime!" After the strenuous training, you are exhausted and say you are leaving. The knight smiles and bids you farewell, saying she looks forward to seeing you next time.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/骑士训练/问好，告别
records.endDes: "Judging by your attire, you are not one of the locals... nor do you seem to be a wandering traveler. Could you be a guest from the surface? Yet I have not heard my father mention this..." After exchanging a few simple greetings, you bid the knight farewell and depart from this place.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/骑士的承诺/借助她的力量
records.endDes: You ask the knight to provide you with combat assistance, and she agrees. After thinking for a moment, she teaches you her unique combat techniques, hoping they will aid you on your journey.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/骑士的承诺/有什么有用的东西吗？
records.endDes: You ask the knight to share some supplies with you, and she readily agrees. She hands you plenty of delicious-looking food... but the moment it touches your hands, it all turns into glimmering dust.

records.idCN: 肉鸽事件/事件选项多次触发/骑士的承诺/要求休息
records.endDes: You need to rest, so you hope the knight can stand guard for you during this time. She readily agrees to your request and even suggests that you can lean against her. When you wake up, the knight has already vanished. Yet you can still seem to feel the warmth she left behind...
